messages:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke results for release v3.14 (canary): 12/16 synth probes passed. kv-prefix probe showing higher noise than baseline in eu-west-1. Link: https://dash/reports/1822500000

mia: Where exactly is the spike? region + route?

adrian: eu-west-1, route /v1/embed -> p50 jitter jumped from ~45ms to ~120ms for short seqs. p95 looks fine. no error increase yet.

sarah: Is this new? any infra/runtime changes in the canary?

adrian: We rolled runtime 0.9.2 with a batching tweak earlier today; suspect interaction with short sequences and KV cache warms.

jack: Options: rollback runtime, or relax probe sensitivity for the canary while we gather more data.

mia: Prefer not to rollback immediately — low user impact. Suggest lowering canary traffic to 25% and tune the smoke probe threshold temporarily.

adrian: Proposed action:
1) scale canary traffic -> 25% (from 50%)
2) update synth probe target_latency_ms -> 200 for 10m window
3) monitor errors/latency and KV cache hit rate
4) if no regressions, resume rollout; if errors jump, rollback runtime

ops-bot: Applying synth probe config change to canary cluster...

ops-bot: Config patch queued:
```
synth_probe:
  target_latency_ms: 200
  window_seconds: 600
  min_samples: 20
  fail_action: rollback
```

mia: Also think we should pin the canary model version to 2.3.1 while we validate the runtime tweak.

adrian: Agreed — pin model -> 2.3.1 for canary; mainline stays unpinned.

sarah: Watching dashboards and logs. I'll flag any increase in 5xx or token drops.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic reduced to 25% and synth probe threshold adjusted. Dashboard: https://dash/canary/overview

jack: :eyes: checking logs and KV hit-rates now.

ops-bot: Note: automatic rollback policy still enabled (3 failing probes in 5m triggers rollback).

mia: :thumbsup: proceed with the tuning and monitor. If stable after 30m, we'll continue rollout to 75%.

adrian: I'll keep an eye and post updates. thanks!
